name: J. J. Murphy (actor)
profileSummary: James Joseph "J.J." Murphy was a Northern Irish film and television actor. He was known for his roles in the films Cal (1984), Angela's Ashes (1999), Mickybo and Me (2004) and Dracula Untold (2014), as well as the Game of Thrones episode "The House of Black and White" (2015), but also known for his roles in theatre. He was also featured in The Sparticle Mystery with him being known as "The Keeper" in the final series.
